methods.anatomical_accuracy: Not assessed by this structural inventory. Table membership can include broad parent concepts, not just direct anatomical names.
methods.triangles: Fan triangulation count; archive source geometry is preserved.
methods.coordinates: Raw source OBJ coordinates. Anatomical directions and units require source documentation and visual verification.
methods.topology: Undirected polygon edges; boundary/nonmanifold counts describe structure and do not establish anatomical validity.

exact_position_weld.precision: exact parsed floating-point coordinate equality; no rounding, tolerance, repair, or decimation
exact_position_weld.scope: Topological diagnostics only. Neither manifold topology nor connectedness establishes anatomical accuracy.
exact_position_weld.rationale: OBJ source can repeat positions at normal seams; raw vertex-index boundary counts alone do not establish holes.

methods.interpretation: Finite coordinates, valid indices, watertight edges, or component counts do not establish anatomical accuracy or the requested aesthetic. Visual and domain review remain separate gates.

source_coordinate_axes.x_positive: anatomical left, verified by official lateralized pectoralis element labels and their coordinate bounds
source_coordinate_axes.y_negative: anterior, supported by pectoralis vs trapezius coordinate locations and initial render-agent inspection
source_coordinate_axes.z_positive: superior, supported by whole-body vertical range and initial render-agent inspection
source_coordinate_axes.units: source coordinate units; physical units not established by the archived README/download pages
